abstract: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) highly purified from urine of the patient with choriocarcinoma contains four asparagine-linked sugar chains in one molecule. The sugar chains were quantitatively liberated as radioactive oligosaccharides from polypeptide portion by hydrazinolysis followed by N-acetylation and NaB3H4 reduction. The structures of these sugar chains were determined by the combination of sequential glycosidase digestion, periodate oxidation, and methylation analysis. As compared with the sugar chains of normal urinary and placental hCG reported previously, they include several prominent structural differences. More than 97% of the sugar chains of choriocarcinoma hCG was free from sialic acid, while the sugar chains of normal hCG were mostly sialylated. Choriocarcinoma hCG contains unusual biantennary complex-type sugar chains in addition to regular tri-, bi-, and monoantennary sugar chains. These sugar chains have two outer chains linked at the C-2 and C-4 positions of the same alpha-mannosyl residue of the trimannosyl core. Since normal hCG does not contain any triantennary sugar chains, occurrence of Gal beta 1 leads to 4GlcNAc beta 1 leads to 4Man alpha 1 leads to group is another characteristic feature of the sugar chains of choriocarcinoma hCG. The evidence that the monoantennary sugar chain of Man alpha 1 leads to 6(Gal beta 1 leads to 4GlcNAc beta 1 leads to 2Man alpha 1 leads to 3)Man beta 1 leads to 4GlcNAc beta 1 leads to 4(Fuc alpha 1 leads to 6)GlcNAc leads to Asn is not found in normal hCG and the sum total of fucosylated sugar chains is 50%, which is twice as much as normal hCG, indicated that fucosylation is also modified in choriocarcinoma tissue.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌患者の尿から高度に精製したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は、1分子中に4本のアスパラギン結合型糖鎖を含んでいた。糖鎖は、ヒドラジン分解、続くN-アセチル化とNaB3H4還元により、ポリペプチド部から定量的に放射性オリゴ糖として遊離させた。糖鎖の構造は、連続的なグリコシダーゼ消化、過ヨウ素酸酸化、メチル化解析の組み合わせにより決定した。正常な尿および胎盤由来hCGの糖鎖と比べると、いくつかの顕著な構造的相違が認められた。絨毛癌hCGの糖鎖の97%以上はシアル酸を含まず、正常hCGの糖鎖の大部分はシアル酸化されていた。絨毛癌hCGには、通常の三分岐、二分岐、一分岐糖鎖に加え、特異な二分岐型複合型糖鎖が含まれていた。これらの糖鎖は、トリマンノースコアの同一のα-マンノシル残基のC-2およびC-4位に結合した2本の外側鎖を有していた。正常hCGには三分岐糖鎖が存在しないため、Galβ1→4GlcNAcβ1→4Manα1→基の出現も絨毛癌hCG糖鎖の特徴であった。正常hCGには見られない一分岐糖鎖の存在、およびフコース化糖鎖の総計が50%で正常hCGの2倍であることは、絨毛癌組織ではフコース化も修飾を受けていることを示した。
